_about: Self-hosted OCR engines: what a page cost on the hardware that read the charted pages, as each run recorded it (#5983). Read by scripts/eval/build-ocr-pareto.mjs, which turns every entry into USD per 1,000 pages. There is no machine-readable GPU fleet ledger yet, so each entry copies the run's own figure from its write-up (`source`) and quotes it; the generator refuses an entry whose quote is not in that file. Gemini is not here: its cost comes from the meter (scripts/eval/ocr-cost-snapshot.mjs). An engine missing from both files has no measured cost; the charts list it as such and do not place it. `basis`: `billed` = the whole billed rental, start-up and idle included; `compute` = inference time × the hourly or monthly rate, which reads low because it assumes the box does nothing else. `charts` limits an entry to the script charts whose pages were read on that hardware; an entry without `charts` applies to the rest. Each entry gives `eur` + `pages`, `eur_per_page`, or `usd_per_1k`, whichever the write-up states.
